milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The purple carpet is placed deep inside the oak plank building at spawn-relative position (5, 0, 7) on a stone floor. With max_distance=5, the player must walk from spawn (distance ~8.6 blocks away) to within 5 blocks of the carpet, requiring them to approach or enter the building. With facing_tolerance=45, the player must deliberately face toward the carpet. At spawn, distance is 8.6 > 5, so the milestone cannot be pre-satisfied.
